name: Akkawi
origin: Levant - Acre region (Palestine, Lebanon, Syria, Cyprus)

moisture_pct.quote: In general, Akawi cheese contains about 51.0% moisture, 21.6% fat, 22.5% protein, and 5% ash.

fat_pct.quote: In general, Akawi cheese contains about 51.0% moisture, 21.6% fat, 22.5% protein, and 5% ash.

compounds.quote: * d 0 A control: acetic acid **131.2±2.8 mg/100g** (=1312 mg/kg), lactic **110.9±0.8 mg/100g**, citric **181.4±4.9 mg/100g**
compounds.name: acetic acid

ammonia.reason: Minimal amino acid deamination/ureolysis in low-proteolysis fresh cheese stored at 4C.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurization and clean brine limit p-cresol/indole/skatole from contaminant microbes.

bitter.reason: Few hydrophobic bitter peptides from primary proteolysis; high salt and high pH suppress perception.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone formation.

browning.reason: Residual lactose/lysine undergoes Maillard when baked for knafeh but pale fresh due to high moisture.

buttery.reason: Low diacetyl/acetoin from Strep. thermophilus citrate metabolism and short cold storage.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Minimal lipolysis and free C4-C6 from pasteurized bovine fat without added lipase and brief aging.

creaminess.reason: 21.6% fat in high-moisture matrix gives smooth but chalky/firm rather than creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Low acid development with intact casein network fractures chalky due to brine salt uptake.

firmness.reason: Rennet gel with colloidal calcium phosphate intact at pH 6.6 plus pressing/brining firms body.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism in unripened curd.

fruity.reason: Very low ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esterification due to low free fatty acids and short age.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks goat-specific 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic branched acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Negligible Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from limited proteolysis in fresh rennet curd.

melt.reason: High pH/high calcium plus 3.9% salt restrict casein hydration so melts after desalting with limited flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No surface mold/Geotrichum lipoxygenase to form 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one.

oil_off.reason: Moderate 21.6% fat pools modestly on heating as protein network contracts.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make, no lignin-derived guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: HPLC acetic ~131 mg/100g plus lactic ~111 mg/100g from thermophilic starter gives mild sour at pH 6.6.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata, no hot-water kneading to align casein, so minimal fibrous stretch when heated.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Pasteurized not cooked curd; low methionine catabolism to methanethiol/DMS in young cheese.

sweet.reason: Small residual lactose/galactose at high pH gives slight sweet whey note.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from limited rennet/chymosin proteolysis at pH 6.6 and days-old age.
